checks.name: learn_items_check
checks.expr: kind = 'text'::text OR media_url IS NOT NULL OR media_id IS NOT NULL

indexes.name: papers_sync_idx
indexes.where: doi IS NOT NULL OR arxiv_id IS NOT NULL

indexes.name: posts_reels_idx
indexes.where: type = 'reel'::text AND status = 'published'::text AND deleted_at IS NULL

checks.name: posts_check
checks.expr: type <> 'text'::text OR caption IS NOT NULL

checks.name: posts_media_check
checks.expr: type = 'text'::text OR media_id IS NOT NULL

checks.name: questions_check
checks.expr: kind = 'short'::text OR options IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(options) >= 2
